Title: 1. The Greatest Show on Earth
description: The dramatic lives of trapeze artists, a clown, and an elephant trainer are told against a background of circus spectacle.

Title: 2. Singin' in the Rain
description: When Hollywood's silent era gives way to talkies, a dashing screen idol and a gifted newcomer navigate romance, rivalry, and the comic chaos of reinventing the movies.

Title: 3. Umberto D.
description: An elderly man and his dog struggle to survive on his government pension in Rome.

Title: 4. Ikiru
description: An aging Tokyo bureaucrat, shaken by a grave diagnosis, breaks from his hollow routine and searches for meaning, connection, and one worthwhile act.

Title: 5. The White Sheik
description: During a day of their honeymoon, newlyweds are separated by the city's lust and the desires it produces.

Title: 6. Forbidden Games
description: A young French girl orphaned in a German air attack is befriended by the son of a poor farmer, and together they try to come to terms with the realities of death.

Title: 7. Fanfan la Tulipe
description: Swashbuckling adventures of young army recruit Fanfan la Tulipe during the reign of King Louis XV in 18th Century France.

Title: 8. Sudden Fear
description: After an ambitious actor ingratiates himself into the life of a wealthy middle-aged playwright and marries her, he plots with his mistress to murder her.

Title: 9. Limelight
description: A fading comedian and a suicidally despondent ballet dancer must look to each other to find purpose and hope in their lives.

Title: 10. High Noon
description: A town Marshal, despite the disagreements of his newlywed bride and the townspeople around him, must face a gang of deadly killers alone at "high noon" when the gang leader, an outlaw he "sent up" years ago, arrives on the noon train.

Title: 11. The Quiet Man
description: An Irish-born boxer returns to his homeland to reclaim his family's farm and begins a turbulent romance with a beautiful spitfire.

Title: 12. Fear and Desire
description: Four soldiers trapped behind enemy lines must confront their fears and desires.

Title: 13. The Bad and the Beautiful
description: An unscrupulous movie producer uses everyone around him: an actress, a director and a writer, in his climb to the top to achieve success.

Title: 14. The Narrow Margin
description: A woman planning to testify against the mob must be protected against potential assassins on the train trip from Chicago to Los Angeles.

Title: 15. Angel Face
description: Ambulance driver Frank Jessup is ensnared in the schemes of the sensuous but dangerous Diane Tremayne.

Title: 16. Monkey Business
description: A chemist finds his personal and professional life turned upside down when one of his chimpanzees finds the fountain of youth.

Title: 17. Bend of the River
description: When a town boss confiscates homesteaders' supplies after gold is discovered nearby, a tough cowboy risks his life to try and get it to them.

Title: 18. The Sniper
description: A sniper kills young brunettes as the police attempt to grapple with the psychology of the unknown assailant.

Title: 19. Plymouth Adventure
description: Trials and tribulations beset the one hundred odd settlers that journey to Virginia in 1620 including unexpectedly arriving in Plymouth, Massachusetts.

Title: 20. The Snows of Kilimanjaro
description: Writer Harry Street reflects on his life as he lies dying from an infection while on safari in the shadow of Mount Kilamanjaro.

Title: 21. Come Back, Little Sheba
description: An emotionally remote recovering alcoholic and his dowdy, unambitious wife face a personal crisis when they take in an attractive lodger.

Title: 22. My Cousin Rachel
description: An 1800s English gentleman thinks his lover is a killer.

Title: 23. The Member of the Wedding
description: Her older brother's wedding forces preteen tomboy Frankie to face her own immaturity.

Title: 24. Europe '51
description: A wealthy woman becomes obsessed with humanitarianism when her young son dies after committing suicide.

Title: 25. We're Not Married!
description: In separate stories, five couples learn that they are not legally married.

Title: 26. Secrets of Women
description: The four wives of four brothers share stories of their marriages as they each wait for their husbands in a small, secluded cottage.

Title: 27. Children of Hiroshima
description: Post war Hiroshima: It's been four years since the last time she visited her hometown. Takako faces the after effects of the A-bomb when she travels around the city to call on old friends.

Title: 28. Kansas City Confidential
description: An ex-con trying to go straight is framed for a million dollar armored car robbery and must go to Mexico in order to unmask the real culprits.

Title: 29. Ivanhoe
description: A knight seeks to free the captive King Richard and put him back on the throne.

Title: 30. Against All Flags
description: Brian Hawke of the Royal Navy versus the pirates of Madagascar.

Title: 31. Deadline - U.S.A.
description: With his newspaper about to be sold, crusading editor Ed Hutcheson tries to complete an exposé on gangster Rienzi.

Title: 32. Viva Zapata!
description: The story of Mexican revolutionary Emiliano Zapata, who led a rebellion against the corrupt, oppressive dictatorship of President Porfirio Díaz in the early 20th century.

Title: 33. Don't Bother to Knock
description: After being dumped by his girlfriend, an airline pilot pursues a babysitter employed by the hotel where he lives and gradually comes to realize that she's dangerous.

Title: 34. Hans Christian Andersen
description: The opening scene of the movie describes it best: "Once upon a time there lived in Denmark a great storyteller named Hans Christian Andersen. This is not the story of his life, but a fairy tale about the great spinner of fairy tales."

Title: 35. O. Henry's Full House
description: John Steinbeck introduces a quintet of O. Henry's most celebrated short stories from his New York Period (1902-1910) in this anthology film.

Title: 36. 5 Fingers
description: During WWII the valet to the British Ambassador to Ankara sells British secrets to the Germans while trying to romance a refugee Polish countess.

Title: 37. Carrie
description: A young girl from a provincial town learns the bitter reality of a big city and great love.

Title: 38. Rancho Notorious
description: After the murder of his fiancée, a Wyoming ranch hand sets out to find her killer.

Title: 39. Scandal Sheet
description: The editor of an exploitation newspaper commits a murder and assigns his protégé to investigate hoping to divert attention away from himself.

Title: 40. Pat and Mike
description: Pat is a women's sports sensation unless her fiancé is around. Her new shady manager Mike keeps them apart and develops feelings for her.

Title: 41. Casque d'Or
description: Three gangsters and an ex-con carpenter all fall for the same beautiful golden-haired woman in Belle Époque France.

Title: 42. The Miracle of Our Lady of Fatima
description: In this story based on true events of 1917, three Portuguese children share a miraculous, prophetic vision of the Virgin Mary.

Title: 43. The World in His Arms
description: In 1850 San Francisco, a Russian Countess runs away from an arranged marriage to a Russian Prince and falls into the arms of an American sea captain who occasionally poaches seals in Russian Alaska.

Title: 44. April in Paris
description: A series of misunderstandings leads to a chorus girl traveling to Paris to represent the American theater, where she falls in love with a befuddled bureaucrat.

Title: 45. Le Plaisir
description: Three short stories about pleasure.

Title: 46. At Sword's Point
description: In 1648 France, it's the sons (and daughter) of the Three Musketeers to the rescue!

Title: 47. Tembo
description: This is an expedition/travelogue, disguised as a documentary with a plot. The 'plot' is that this Howard Hill expedition has come to Africa in search of a legendary tribe of "Leopard Men' (a term used in RKO's 1946 "Tarzan and the Leopard Woman", which just happened to be available as a re-release at the time), and the booming voice of narrator Westbrook Van Voorhis would mention 'The Leopard Men' from time to time, but they did not find any 'Leopard Men', and did not expect to find any 'Leopard Men', but they did find tribes of tall natives and a friendly-but-shy tribe of short natives (Pygmies). It allows Mr. Hill to show off his legendary skills as an archer, especially when the jungle denizens menace the members of the expedition, and sometimes even when they didn't. It is a time capsule in that it shows Africa as it was and wasn't, and gets into native food-hunts, life-styles, customs and living-habits.

Title: 48. Invitation
description: A millionaire tries to buy his dying daughter a husband.

Title: 49. Dracula in Istanbul
description: Azmi is a lawyer from Istanbul. Drakula of Romania has assumed a new title. Azmi travels to Romania for legal matters. He is warned of Drakula but Azmi is a strong believer of goodness.

Title: 50. The Crimson Pirate
description: During the 1700s, pirate Captain Vallo seizes a British warship and gets involved in various money-making schemes involving Caribbean rebels led by El Libre, British envoy Baron Jose Gruda, and a beautiful courtesan named Consuelo.

Title: 51. Scaramouche
description: In France during the late 18th Century, a man sets out to avenge the death of his friend at the hands of a master swordsman.

Title: 52. Moulin Rouge
description: Fictional account of French artist Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.

Title: 53. Boots Malone
description: Rich kid ducks school and goes to the racetrack to learn how to be a jockey.

Title: 54. Springfield Rifle
description: Major Lex Kearney becomes the North's first counterespionage agent as he tries to discover who's behind the theft of Union cavalry horses in Colorado during the Civil War.

Title: 55. The Star
description: A washed-up movie queen finds romance, but still desires a comeback.

Title: 56. Oklahoma Annie
description: A storekeeper gets involved in cleaning up corruption in her town, and also hopes to attract the attention of the handsome new sheriff.

Title: 57. Clash by Night
description: Mae Doyle comes back to her hometown a cynical woman. Her brother Joe fears that his love, fish cannery worker Peggy, may wind up like Mae. Mae marries Jerry and has a baby; she is happy but restless, drawn to Jerry's friend Earl.

Title: 58. The Black Castle
description: Man investigates the disappearance of two of his friends who were the guests of a sinister Austrian count.

Title: 59. The Story of Robin Hood and His Merrie Men
description: When King Richard the Lionheart leaves England to lead a crusade to the Holy Land, his treacherous brother conspires to bring himself to power.

Title: 60. Macao
description: Nick Cochran, an American in exile in Macao, has a chance to restore his name by helping capture an international crime lord. Undercover, can he mislead the bad guys and still woo the attractive singer/petty crook, Julie Benson?

Title: 61. The Big Sky
description: The success of the journey focuses on keeping the Indian girl alive as well as themselves to complete trade with the Blackfeet.

Title: 62. The Life of Oharu
description: Follows a woman's fight and survival amid the vicissitudes of life and the cruelty of society.

Title: 63. The Cimarron Kid
description: Unjustly accused of robbing the train he was riding home, Bill Doolin re-joins his old gang, participates in other robberies and becomes a wanted outlaw.

Title: 64. The Importance of Being Earnest
description: After Algernon discovers that his friend Ernest, has created a fictional brother for whenever he needs a reason to escape dull country life, Algernon poses as the brother, resulting in ever-increasing confusion.

Title: 65. The Big Trees
description: A Quaker colony tries to save the giant sequoias from a timber baron.

Title: 66. Road to Bali
description: Two unemployed show-biz pals accept treasure-diving work in Bali for a local princess and they find treasure, love and trouble.

Title: 67. She's Working Her Way Through College
description: A burlesque dancer goes to college, where she romances a professor and helps put on a musical show.

Title: 68. Dreamboat
description: Respected college professor Thornton Sayre is plagued when his old movies are shown on TV, and sets out with his daughter to stop it. However, his former co-star is the hostess of the TV show playing his films, and she has other plans.

Title: 69. The Lusty Men
description: Retired rodeo champion Jeff McCloud agrees to mentor novice rodeo contestant Wes Merritt against the wishes of Merritt's wife who fears the dangers of this rough sport.

Title: 70. The Prisoner of Zenda
description: An Englishman vacationing in a Ruritarian kingdom is recruited to impersonate his cousin, the soon-to-be-crowned king, after the monarch is drugged and kidnapped.

Title: 71. The Little World of Don Camillo
description: A determined priest and a Communist mayor develop a grudging friendship in spite of their official rivalry.

Title: 72. Jack and the Beanstalk
description: Abbott and Costello's version of the famous fairy tale, about a young boy who trades the family cow for magic beans.

Title: 73. Hangman's Knot
description: A Confederate Major and his troops are falsely led to believe the Civil War is not over, and become wanted men after they attack a Union Army wagon train in Nevada.

Title: 74. Carbine Williams
description: David Marshall Williams is sent to a prison farm where he works in the tool shop and eventually develops the precursor of the famous M-1 Carbine automatic rifle used in World War II.

Title: 75. Bela Lugosi Meets a Brooklyn Gorilla
description: Two goofy entertainers meet a mad scientist on a jungle island.

Title: 76. The Duel at Silver Creek
description: Marshal Tyrone and the Silver Kid form an uneasy alliance against a gang of claim jumpers.

Title: 77. Lovely to Look At
description: Three Broadway producers struggling to get backing for their show, hope one's sudden inheritance of a half interest in a Parisian fashion house is the answer. They travel to Paris only to learn the salon is in debt and requires their help.

Title: 78. Ruby Gentry
description: A sexy but poor young girl marries a rich man she doesn't love, but carries a torch for another man.

Title: 79. The Sound Barrier
description: Fictionalized story of British aerospace engineers solving the problem of supersonic flight.

Title: 80. Affair in Trinidad
description: Nightclub singer and her brother-in-law try to find her husband's killer.

Title: 81. Shin Shinaki Boobla Boo
description: Shin Shinaki's parents were murdered. She vows revenge against their killer. Supported by bandit lover Boobla Boo, she searches for the murderer.

Title: 82. Phone Call from a Stranger
description: While awaiting a delayed flight, a lawyer who has left his unfaithful wife befriends three fellow passengers. After the plane crashes and he is among the few to survive, he feels compelled to contact the families of his dead friends.

Title: 83. Son of Paleface
description: Junior Potter returns to claim his father's gold, which is nowhere to be found. "Mike" is the luscious head of a gang of thieves, and Roy Barton is the federal marshal hot on her trail.

Title: 84. Room for One More
description: New Jersey couple Anna and Poppy Rose become foster parents to several kids born into less fortunate circumstances, including a desperately unhappy 13-year-old girl and a physically handicapped boy with a penchant for getting into serious trouble.

Title: 85. The Ringer
description: A criminal master of disguise nicknamed The Ringer is out for deadly revenge against a treacherous London lawyer who is under police protection.

Title: 86. Invasion, U.S.A.
description: A group of people at a bar witness the unfolding events of a Soviet invasion of the USA.

Title: 87. The Golden Coach
description: Three men of varying social standing - a viceroy, a bullfighter, and a soldier - vie for the affections of an actress in 18th-century Peru.

Title: 88. Stolen Face
description: A doctor repairs a female inmate's disfigured face to match the lovely woman who left him, and marries her, only to find out how abusive she is.

Title: 89. The White Reindeer
description: A newlywed woman goes to the local shaman to get some help with her love life, but instead she gets turned into a white reindeer vampire.

Title: 90. Paula
description: Distraught after her second miscarriage & learning definitively she could never have children Paula, while driving at night, accidentally injures a child. Confused and due to her commitment to attend a function that honors her husband she doesn't follow the child to the hospital as she thought she would. She attempts to tell her husband about the incident but has trouble finding the right time. Later, overcome with remorse, she looks to get close to this child and becomes a helper at the hospital. The child is an orphan with limited health care available. The doctor recognizes Paula's need to be useful and asks if she would become his speech therapist and guardian. She finds meaning and purpose in her life as she engages the little boy in intensive therapy necessary to recover his ability to speak. Will she be caught and punished, when the boy is able to speak, will he implicate her?

Title: 91. Diplomatic Courier
description: A US State Department courier tangles with Soviet agents and seductive women in post WW2 Europe.

Title: 92. Abbott and Costello Meet Captain Kidd
description: Rocky and Puddin' Head are waiting tables at an inn on Tortuga when a letter given them by Lady Jane for delivery to Martingale gets switched with a treasure map. Kidd and Bonney kidnap them to Skull Island to find said treasure.

Title: 93. Red Planet Mars
description: An American scientist is able to contact and communicate with Mars with shattering political, economic, and spiritual repercussions.

Title: 94. Radar Men from the Moon
description: Strategic targets on Earth are being destroyed by an unknown weapon. Government security head Henderson suspects it's an "atomic ray" originating from the moon.

Title: 95. The Girl in the Bikini
description: Gérard, a young student, discovers a fragment from a Phoenician amphora in Corsica. Several years later he sets off on a smuggling boat, looking for the treasure he thinks he has found. When he get back to island, he falls in love.

Title: 96. Curtain Up
description: In a small town in the 1950s, a repertory company meets on Monday morning to start rehearsing the following week's play. This is a ghastly thing written by the aunt of one of the theatre's directors. The producer doesn't try to hide his annoyance about it, and is further exercised when the authoress arrives to help. The cast have to try and sort out real-life problems that keep intruding as they wrestle with the play's dire dialogue.

Title: 97. The Turning Point
description: Jerry McKibbon is a tough, no nonsense reporter, mentoring special prosecutor John Conroy in routing out corrupt officials in the city, which may even include Conroy's own police detective father as a suspect.

Title: 98. The Promoter
description: Edward Machin, an Edwardian-era young rogue of lowly origin, decides he must do what he can to raise his living standards in order to see the world and shape his own destiny.

Title: 99. Sailor Beware
description: Although allergic to kissing girls, Seaman Melvin Jones, through a fluke TV appearance, gets the undeserved reputation of a great kisser dubbed "Mr. Temptation" and is pursued by amorous young females.

Title: 100. Folly to Be Wise
description: Newly arrived Army chaplin Captain Paris (Alastair Sim) attempts to book various acts for the entertainment of a troop of soldiers.

Title: 101. Red Ball Express
description: Story of the military truck drivers who kept the Allied armies supplied in Europe during World War II.

Title: 102. The Stranger in Between
description: A violent fugitive and a mistreated small boy team up to flee from authority.

Title: 103. The Flavor of Green Tea Over Rice
description: A childless middle-aged couple faces a marital crisis.

Title: 104. Hellgate
description: After the Civil War, an ex-Confederate ranch owner is framed and sent to a brutal desert prison in New Mexico.

Title: 105. The Steel Trap
description: A Los Angeles bank assistant-manager devises a plan to steal money from the bank's vault and to flee to Brazil with his unsuspecting wife.

Title: 106. What Price Glory
description: The wartime romantic misadventures of Captain Flagg, commander of a company of US Marines in 1918 France.

Title: 107. The Thief
description: A chance accident causes a nuclear physicist, who's selling top secret material to the Russians, to fall under FBI scrutiny and go on the run.

Title: 108. Ghost Ship
description: A luxury ship is haunted by the ghosts of a crew that had disappeared off the ship years before.

Title: 109. The Hundred Hour Hunt
description: Scotland Yard is mobilised in the hunt for blood donors in a race to save a dying girl.

Title: 110. The Pickwick Papers
description: Four wealthy Victorian gentlemen led by Samuel Pickwick set forth on an objective study of human behavior, thwarted by con artist Mr. Jingle and one of his schemes leading to Pickwick being put on trial for breaking a promise to marry.

Title: 111. The Marrying Kind
description: Florence and Chet Keefer have had a troublesome marriage. Whilst in the middle of a divorce hearing, the judge encourages them to remember the good times they have had, hoping that the marriage can be saved.

Title: 112. Stars and Stripes Forever
description: A film biography of the composer John Philip Sousa, from his early days in the Marine Corps Band through the Spanish-American War in 1898.

Title: 113. Thunder in the East
description: In a remote region of post-independence India, the love of a blind British woman pricks the conscience of an arms dealer.

Title: 114. Carson City
description: When a banker finds his stagecoach shipments of gold from Carson City are vulnerable to holdups, he commissions the building of a railroad through the mountains.

Title: 115. Something to Live For
description: An actress becomes an alcoholic after being jilted. She is aided by an Alcoholics Anonymous member with whom she has an affair; however, he is married.

Title: 116. Beware, My Lovely
description: A mentally disturbed handyman on the run, for reasons even he doesn't understand, takes a job at the house of a lonely war widow in 1918.

Title: 117. Crow Hollow
description: 1952. Drama. Directed by Michael McCarthy. Starring Natasha Parry & Donald Houston. In a spooky mansion, one of three sinister spinsters tries to poison her nephew's wife to steal a large inheritance.

Title: 118. Blackbeard, the Pirate
description: Honest Edward Maynard finds himself serving as ship's surgeon under the infamous pirate Blackbeard.

Title: 119. Zombies of the Stratosphere
description: The invaders come to Earth to create an H-bomb to blast Earth out of orbit so that Mars can take its place.

Title: 120. Lone Star
description: Ex-President Andrew Jackson sends Texan Devereaux Burke back home on a mission to facilitate Sam Houston's drive for U.S. statehood.

Title: 121. Son of Ali Baba
description: Kashma Baba, the son of the famed Baghdad thief Ali Baba is a cadet in a medieval Persian military academy where he runs afoul of his rival Hussein, the evil Caliph's son.

Title: 122. The Belle of New York
description: Playboy Charlie Hill meets beautiful Angela Bonfils, a mission house worker in the Bowery. He genuinely falls in love, so, dedicated to winning her over, Charlie cleans up his act and even gets a job as a driver to impress her.

Title: 123. Red Skies of Montana
description: Drama dealing with the hazardous work of the U. S. Forest Service's paratroop fire-fighters in Montana.

Title: 124. Big Jim McLain
description: In the post-war Hawaii, House Un-American Activities Committee investigators Jim McLain and Mal Baxter hunt down Communists.

Title: 125. Above and Beyond
description: The life of Col. Paul Tibbets, who piloted the plane that dropped the atomic bomb on Hiroshima in World War II.

Title: 126. Pony Soldier
description: In 1876, a Canadian North West Mounted Police Constable must obtain the release of white hostages captured by the Cree tribes that are raiding Montana from their Canadian reservation.

Title: 127. Million Dollar Mermaid
description: Biopic of Australian swimming champ and entertainer Annette Kellerman. After overcoming polio, Kellerman achieves fame and creates a scandal when her one-piece bathing suit is considered indecent.

Title: 128. Murder on Monday
description: David Preston, a banker, has a 24-hour memory lapse. Accused of robbery and murder, he can't account for his lost time. With no alibi, police press him to explain the missing hours, jeopardizing his freedom.

Title: 129. Wagons West
description: Wagon master Jeff leads a pioneer train to Oregon, taking in runaway boy Ben despite opposition. Conflict ensues with cook's nephew who desires Ben's sister. Indian raids trouble the journey after some travelers illegally sell rifles.

Title: 130. The Las Vegas Story
description: The arrival in Las Vegas of a businessman and his glamorous wife creates a complex web of murder and deceit.

Title: 131. The Savage
description: A white boy raised by the Sioux must choose sides when the Sioux threaten to go to war against the Whites.

Title: 132. Outlaw Women
description: This rather unusual 50s western is set in a town where men may not enter. The town is controlled by a woman gambler who eventually succumbs to the allure of a handsome and persistent cowboy.

Title: 133. Crazy for Love
description: To inherit his uncle's hotel and restaurant Hyppolyte, a naive and simple man, must pass his primary school exam.

Title: 134. Bwana Devil
description: British railway workers in Kenya are becoming the favorite snack of two man-eating lions. Head engineer Bob Hayward becomes obsessed with trying to kill the beasts before they maul everyone on his crew.

Title: 135. Island of Desire
description: In 1943, an Allied hospital ship is sunk by the Japanese in the South Pacific where a nurse and a Marine become marooned on an island abandoned by natives.

Title: 136. Horizons West
description: Two brothers end up on opposite sides of the law in post-Civil War Texas.

Title: 137. The Holly and the Ivy
description: An English clergyman's neglect of his grown children, in his zeal to tend to his parishioners, comes to the surface at a Christmas family gathering.

Title: 138. The Outcasts of Poker Flat
description: Trapped in a snowbound mountain cabin, an assortment of travelers receives the unwelcome visit of a wanted outlaw.

Title: 139. Has Anybody Seen My Gal
description: An aging heir-less millionaire wants to leave his fortune to the unsuspecting family of his first love but not before testing his prospective heirs by living with them under the guise of a poor boarder.

Title: 140. Skirts Ahoy!
description: Three women in three different situations report for induction at the Great Lakes Naval Training Station and end up roommates. What follows is a frothy and fun musical as they join the navy to find husbands.

Title: 141. Belles on Their Toes
description: The "Cheaper by the Dozen" crew is back, sans Clifton Webb. Lillian is struggling to make ends meet without her husband's income, while Anne, Martha, and Ernestine find romance.

Title: 142. Because of You
description: A female ex-con falls in love and hesitates to reveal her past.

Title: 143. Bugles in the Afternoon
description: After violently attacking a fellow officer Lt. Edward Garnett, cavalry Captain Kern Shafter is court martialled. Later, he rejoins the army with Custer's regiment at Fort Lincoln, Dakota, becoming a sergeant, where he runs into his old foe.

Title: 144. El bombero atómico
description: Cantinflas is a clumsy fireman, who one day receives the visit of his little goddaughter, whose mother recently died in the jungle. After having work in a few fires, Cantinflas decided to quit and become a policeman, because is less dangerous. Everything goes well until a gang of gangsters kidnap the girl, because of a monetary inheritance.

Title: 145. La ausente
description: A man suffers great pain for the death of his wife in an automobile accident and decides to investigate the surroundings of the accident that he thinks are mysterious

Title: 146. The Captive City
description: A small town newspaperman's investigation into a local bookie operation turns up a web of organized crime.

Title: 148. The Beast Must Die
description: When his child is hit by a car, a writer of thrillers is desperate to avenge his death and goes in search of the murderer.

Title: 149. Wild Stallion
description: After his parents' murder and his horse Top Kick vanished, Dan Light grew up to become an Army horse tracker-a role that may help him finally find his beloved companion.

Title: 150. Eight Iron Men
description: While holed-up in a bombed-out, rainy Italian city in WW2, Sergeant Joe Mooney is ordered by the company commander to fall back with his squad rather than rescuing a comrade trapped in a watery shell hole by a German machine-gunner.

Title: 151. Angels One Five
description: The story of an RAF fighter squadron at the height of the Battle of Britain.

Title: 152. The Machine to Kill Bad People
description: A photographer in a small fishing village is visited by a man who claims to be Saint Andrea. The Saint gives him a special camera device to solve the village's ills - by taking a photograph of an existing picture, the photo subject dies.

Title: 153. Denver & Rio Grande
description: A romanticized history of the building of the Denver & Rio Grande Railroad in the Colorado mountains.

Title: 154. The Battle at Apache Pass
description: When Cochise bands together with Geronimo and other Indian tribes, Major Colton abandons his fort, heading towards Fort Sheridan, through Apache Pass. The only thing in his way are the Indians he used to call his friends.

Title: 155. The Lawless Breed
description: After being released from prison, former gun-fighter John Wesley Hardin hopes to have his autobiography published in order to rehabilitate his tarnished reputation.

Title: 156. Botany Bay
description: In 1787, American medical student Hugh Tallant and British convicts are sent from London to New South Wales on a ship commanded by the evil Captain Gilbert.

Title: 157. Rome 11:00
description: Five women interviewed for a job in 1951 Rome. A staircase collapsed during chaos, injuring many. The film follows how this incident impacted their different lives, some finding change, others disappointment.

Title: 158. Lure of the Wilderness
description: In a Georgia swamp, a young hunter stumbles upon a wanted fugitive and his daughter, and helps them return to civilization.

Title: 159. My Man and I
description: In California, a Mexican-American is falsely accused of shooting the farmer he was working for, after the racist farmer stiffed his immigrant employee with a bad check.

Title: 160. Park Row
description: The Globe is a small, but visionary newspaper started by Phineas Mitchell, an editor recently fired by The Star. The two newspapers become enemies, and the Star's ruthless heiress Charity Hackett decides to eliminate the competition.

Title: 161. With a Song in My Heart
description: A talented singer's musical career begins to soar.

Title: 162. Montana Belle
description: In Oklahoma, outlaw Belle Starr joins the Dalton gang but she causes a romantic rivalry and a rift between the gang members, especially on the eve of the planned robbery of a bank where a posse is secretly waiting in ambush.

Title: 163. Mutiny
description: During the War of 1812, the U.S. tasks Captain James Marshall to sail through the British blockade and bring back a French loan in gold but the secret leaks out and many greedy hands, including the mutinous crew's, are after the gold.

Title: 164. The Paris Express
description: A Dutch company's owner bankrupts his own company, burns the incriminating ledgers and plans to run to Paris with the company funds but he is caught in the act by his accountant who challenges his actions, leading to a reversal of roles.

Title: 165. Si yo fuera diputado
description: Tired of the same politicians, who never do anything to improve their welfare, people from a poor neighborhood decide to support the local barber boy (Cantinflas) for public office.

Title: 166. Man Bait
description: The married owner of a bookstore is attracted to his sexy blonde clerk. He finally gives in to temptation and makes a pass at her, but that only results in him getting enmeshed in blackmail and murder.

Title: 167. The Happy Time
description: Spring inspires lessons in love and life for a French family in 1920s Ottawa, especially for teenage Robert, who's blind to the attentions of an American neighbor girl, because he's infatuated with the beautiful new maid, fleeing life as a magician's assistant.

Title: 168. Off Limits
description: Two Army buddies fight, as one falls in love with the other's aunt, a nightclub singer.

Title: 169. Secret People
description: This tale of intrigue finds Valentina Cortese involved in an assassination plot. She helps the police apprehend the conspirators after an innocent bystander is accidentally killed.

Title: 170. The Pride of St. Louis
description: The story of Jerome "Dizzy" Dean, a major-league baseball pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals and Chicago Cubs in the 1930s and 1940s.

Title: 171. Les Miserables
description: A parole violator in early 19th Century France is relentlessly pursued and persecuted by an obsessive policeman.

Title: 172. The Winning Team
description: Nebraska farmboy Grover Cleveland Alexander achieves baseball stardom before war injuries and alcoholism derail his career, but through his wife's faithful efforts he gets a chance for a comeback and redemption.

Title: 173. Manon of the Spring
description: To avenge her father's death, Manon blocks the source of water for local villagers.

Title: 174. Loan Shark
description: At the request of factory owners and union leaders, a tough ex-con infiltrates a gang of loan sharks who are preying on financially desperate factory workers.

Title: 175. My Son John
description: The Jeffersons are the ideal picture-perfect all-American family in a small town, but their eldest son John returns home after a long absence spouting views that cause them to worry he may be a Communist.

Title: 176. If I Should Die Before I Wake
description: Lucio Santana's prankster friend reveals a man's suspicious behavior with lollipops. When she's murdered, Lucio must decide between keeping his vow or informing his detective father about the potential killer.

Title: 177. Lost in Alaska
description: Two firemen rescue a gold miner from suicide. However, discovering the police want them for murder, they travel with the miner to Alaska to help chase his girl. There, they discover that the town wants the miner dead.

Title: 178. This Woman Is Dangerous
description: A tough lady gangster learns that she will be totally blind within a week. She seeks help from the one eye surgeon who may be able to save her sight. In the process, he also causes her to have a change of heart.

Title: 179. Mother
description: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

Title: 180. Two Cents Worth of Hope
description: A love story between a poor fellow and a daughter of respected workshop owner set in an Italian post-war village.

Title: 181. Penne nere
description: Penne Nere is set in Italy during the last crucial two years of World War II, after the Badoglio government signed an armistice with the Allies. Throughout the nation the original Fascist army is disbanded and soldiers are pretty much on their own. One such soldier is Pietro (Marcello Mastroianni), who is on his way to his home village of Stella and his beloved Gemma. Once in the village, he gets involved with other soldiers and the villagers in an action to prevent a battalion of Germans from blowing up their dam.

Title: 182. Crash of Silence
description: Mandy Garland was born deaf and has been mute for all of her life. Her parents believe she is able to speak if she can only be taught, and they enroll her with a special teacher.

Title: 183. One Minute to Zero
description: During the early days of the Korean War, U.S. Army colonel Steve Janowski is one of the military advisers training the South Korean army and he's tasked with evacuating American civilians from the war zone.

Title: 184. California Conquest
description: In the 1840s, most Californians want their state to break away from Mexico and possibly join the USA but Russia, Britain and France aim to grab California for themselves.

Title: 185. Without Warning!
description: Quiet, unobtrusive LA citizen Carl Martin picks up look-alikes for his estranged blonde wife and murders them with garden shears.

Title: 186. The Curious Adventures of Mr. Wonderbird
description: A chimney sweep and his beloved shepherdess are aided by Wonderbird (Sir Peter Ustinov) in their escape from a ruthless dictator.

Title: 187. The Wild North
description: In the Canadian mountains, a trapper goes on the run accused of a crime, and is pursued by a rugged and determined lawman of the Royal North-West Mounted Police.

Title: 188. Heidi
description: When Heidi, a little girl who leads an idyllic life with her grandfather in the Alps, is cruelly taken from the mountain retreat by a stern aunt, she adapts to life in the village below by bringing humor and goodwill to every situation.

Title: 189. Dans la vie tout s'arrange
description: An American woman arrives to a small French town where she has inherited a chateau, only to discover it is already inhabited by squatters.

Title: 190. Captain Scarlett
description: Post-Napoleonic Wars, Scarlett returns to southern France. He rescues a princess from a forced marriage, defends locals from the Duke of Corlais' persecution, and ultimately overthrows the Duke's oppressive rule.

Title: 191. I Dream of Jeanie
description: The life and career of famed American composer Stephen Foster.

Title: 192. Por ellas aunque mal paguen
description: Mr. Anastacio, an aristocrat who is going through a bad patch, marries his daughter Isabel to a wealthy rancher. Isabel and her family refuse to work, so Jose Manuel takes them to the ranch, where they are forced to work to be able to eat.

Title: 193. The Green Glove
description: An ex-soldier and his new girlfriend comb France for a valuable relic...which others are willing to kill for.

Title: 194. Aaron Slick from Punkin Crick
description: Shy farmboy loves his next-door neighbor, but she dreams of going to the big city. Then she gets mixed up with big-city gangsters.

Title: 195. Beauties of the Night
description: A young composer has vivid dreams of the past that reflect, yet conflict with his waking life.

Title: 196. Whispering Smith vs. Scotland Yard
description: US sleuth Whispering Smith arrives in London on vacation, but soon becomes embroiled in a murder case.

Title: 197. Flesh and Fury
description: A deaf boxer is exploited by a gold-digging blonde.

Title: 198. I'll Get You
description: After leading nuclear scientists are kidnapped and smuggled behind the Iron Curtain, an FBI man and a British agent are assigned to catch the kidnappers.

Title: 199. The Moment of Truth
description: On the night of their tenth anniversary, Doctor Pierre Richard accidentally discovers that his wife, actress Madeleine, has been having an affair with a disturbed artist, Daniel Prevost who has just attempted suicide. He confronts her and she spends the night trying to explain the reasons for her infidelity...he took their marriage for granted, he spent too much time at work, he appeared to be attracted to his pretty assistant and on and on...in two languages and some badly dubbed English. Will he buy this? Will they stay together?

Title: 200. The Iron Mistress
description: The exploits of nineteenth-century pioneer Jim Bowie after settling in New Orleans.

Title: 201. The Jazz Singer
description: Jerry dreams of becoming a famous jazz singer, but to accomplish that, he must defy his father, a Jewish Cantor who opposes such a dream as a future for a son of his.

Title: 202. Ahí viene Martín Corona
description: Martin Corona (Infante) and Eulalio Gonzalez "Piporro" are local heroes that help the poor, the unfortunate and women in need. But Carmen Linares and Rosario Medina - double character - performed in by Sara Montiel won't fall for Martin Corona's charms. Infante sings "Cuando el destino", "Copa tras copa" and "Carta a Eufemia". Jose Alfredo Jimenez sings "Paloma Querida" and "El Corrido de Martin Corona".

Title: 203. Assignment: Paris
description: Cold war intrigue in France and Hungary.

Title: 204. Stranger on the Prowl
description: A nameless, homeless and rejected man who is looking for a new life and a young boy from an impoverished family, who is forced to steal when he loses the milk money. These two come together in the same hiding place.

Title: 205. Captive Women
description: In a post-apocalyptic New York City, three tribes of mutants (the Norms, the Mutates and the Upriver people) battle each other to survive.

Title: 206. The Faithful City
description: Produced in Israel in English with an international cast, "The Faithful City" depicts some of the courage, patience, bravery and understanding that attended the birth of Israel as a free and independent nation. The larger story is told within the framework of a simple story regarding the rehabilitation of orphaned-children from war-ravaged Europe. Sam, a counselor from a boy's camp in New York state, is at first confident that children are children no matter what their backgrounds. He soon finds the young refugees to be mature, tough, and living by the creed of 'survival at any cost.' One of the children,Max, frustrates Sam by his dishonesty and cockiness.

Title: 207. Untamed Frontier
description: Squeezed between Mexico and the Denbow family lands lies the U.S. government free grazing land but the incoming settlers cannot reach it without trespassing on the Denbow property which is defended by an army of Denbow cowhands.

Title: 208. Three Girls from Rome
description: Three beautiful seamstresses from one of the fashionable dress salons near the Piazza de Spagna in Rome gather on the steps of the square to eat lunch and talk of their love lives. Marisa, the oldest in a large family, is engaged to a truck driver; Elena lives with her widowed mother and is in love with an opportunist, Alberto, who is also romancing the boss's daughter; Lucia lives on the outskirts of Rome, where a small-in-stature jockey worships her but, she, however has eyes for only tall men, and keeps many of those on a string.

Title: 209. Androcles and the Lion
description: Story of a Christian in ancient Rome who befriends a lion.

Title: 210. Flat Top
description: During the Korean War, aboard the U.S.S. Princeton, Navy Commander Dan Collier reminisces about his first assignment on the same aircraft carrier in the war against Japan.

Title: 211. The First Time
description: Expectant parents Joe and Betsy Bennett anxiously await the arrival of their new baby. Then after the baby arrives, they discover the unpleasant side of parenting: sleepless nights, extra bills and no more free time.

Title: 212. Glory at Sea
description: In 1940, the Captain of an old Royal Navy destroyer struggles with his crew, as well as the Nazis.

Title: 213. Operation Secret
description: While under attack by German forces, a French army unit discovers there is a traitor in their midst, feeding the Germans information.

Title: 214. The Emperor and the Golem
description: Emperors baker and Bakers emperor - it refers to the fact that in movie just a regular young baker gets switched with real old Emperor which leaves everyone thinking that emperor did get younger by drinking the potion of youth.

Title: 215. We Are All Murderers
description: The problem of the reasonableness of capital punishment.

Title: 216. Vampire Over London
description: Vampire seeks world domination via experiments. Mistakenly delivered radar-controlled robot transports him and Mother Riley, leading to confrontation as she tries stopping Vampire's scheme.

Title: 217. Untamed Women
description: During World War II, an American bomber pilot is rescued after drifting at sea aboard a raft.

Title: 218. Fargo
description: Bill's brother dies due to a stampede started by cattlemen. Barb wire is installed to keep herds away from lands cultivated by farmers. The cattlemen state that the wire is dangerous to their herds but lose the case in court. War begins.

Title: 219. Night Without Sleep
description: Awaking one morning out of a drunken stupor, composer Richard Morton can't shake the feeling he has murdered a woman during the night.

Title: 220. The Merry Widow
description: Operating under royal orders, a count must woo a young and wealthy widow in order to save a kingdom from bankruptcy.

Title: 221. Never Open That Door
description: Two separate episodes that have in common the door that separates good from evil.

Title: 222. The Witch
description: Archaeological team unearths a body of a young woman, who was told to be a witch buried in the bog some 300 years ago. Soon a naked woman appears and drives the men of the village crazy. Everybody is certain that this really is the witch killed in days of yore. At the end the wild happenings during those few days appeared to be a dream of the professor leading the excavations.

Title: 223. When in Rome
description: An American fugitive flees to Rome and tries to elude capture by masquerading as a priest.

Title: 224. Hoodlum Empire
description: After WW2, ex-mobster war hero Joe Gray goes straight, to the dismay of his New York mob boss uncle who's afraid that his nephew will testify against his outfit before a Grand Jury.

Title: 225. El rebozo de Soledad
description: Melodrama about Dr. Alberto Robles, an idealistic city physician living in a rural community ruled by macho customs and feudalistic landowners, who falls for Soledad, a peasant woman.

Title: 226. Thunderbirds
description: An Oklahoma National Guard unit, comprised mainly of Native Americans, is called up for duty at the start of World War II.

Title: 227. Torpedo Alley
description: Carrier pilot Lieutenant Bob Bingham (Mark Stevens) is rescued at sea by a submarine after he freezes at the controls and crashes, killing his two crewmen. He returns to civilian life but soon afterwards, looking for redemption, applies for submarine duty. At the New London, Conn., training base he renews acquaintance with Commander Heywood (James Millican) and Lieutenant Gates (Douglas Kennedy), the skipper and engineering officers of the sub that rescued him at sea. Bingham falls in love with Navy nurse Lieutenant Susan Peabody (Dorothy Malone), daughter of Warrant Officer Peabody (Charles Winninger) and the steady girl friend of Gates. Heywood gets a submarine command at the outbreak of the Korean "police action" and Bingham and his friend, Lieutenant Graham (Bill Williams), are part of the officer's group on Heywood's sub.

Title: 228. The Atomic City
description: An atomic scientist's son is kidnapped by enemy agents.

Title: 229. The Savage Princess
description: After ascending to the throne, King Shamsher Singh begins a reign of terror and oppression. A young commoner named Jai then decides to challenge the king and kidnaps his sister.

Title: 230. Ma and Pa Kettle on Vacation
description: The Kettles are in Paris along with their daughter-in-law's parents, the Parkers. Pa tries to buy racy postcards. He also gets in big trouble when he is given a letter to deliver to Adolph Wade, a spy who gets killed by spies Inez and Cyrus Kraft.

Title: 231. Cripple Creek
description: Lawmen infiltrate bandit gang to catch mining crooks.

Title: 232. La figlia del diavolo
description: Garibaldi moves on to Naples. The liberals are overjoyed but the Bourbons are terrified. Baron Tucci, on a recommendation from England, arrives at the home of Count Sereni. But he turns out a degraded Bourbon official and spy.

Title: 233. The Gentle Gunman
description: In 1941, in wartime U.K., two Irish brothers working for the I.R.A. come against their local leader's ruthless methods.

Title: 234. Scotland Yard Inspector
description: An English woman asks an American detective visiting London to help find her brother's killer.

Title: 235. Tarzan's Savage Fury
description: Tarzan acts as a guide for two British government agents recently arrived in Africa to secure a great cache of diamonds for the English military. However, the agents are not what they seem.

Title: 236. Chained for Life
description: A Siamese twin kills the husband who left her. The courts have to decide if she is convicted of murder, how can they punish her sister, who had nothing to do with the crime?

Title: 237. Okinawa
description: Captain Hale takes over command of a U. S. Naval vessel as it prepares to take part in the invasion of Okinawa in the Second World War. His crew includes a rowdy gun crew who punctuate fire missions with banter and antics.

Title: 238. The Half-Breed
description: There is a fortune in gold on Apache land, and Archer, a dirty politician, intends to have it. Things reach the boiling point, but Young, a slick gambler, comes along and saves the day.

Title: 239. Way of a Gaucho
description: In 1875 Argentina, after killing a man, a gaucho is sentenced to harsh army duty but he deserts the army and becomes a bandit leader.

Title: 240. Fort Osage
description: A greedy Missouri merchant overcharges the westbound settlers for goods and for passage to California while also stealing the Osages' supplies who consequently start attacking all passing wagon trains.

Title: 241. Japanese War Bride
description: Korean War veteran returns home to rural Salinas, California with his new Japanese wife, whom he met at a war hospital. The couple are forced to deal with the sometimes subtle, sometimes overt racism of his family and the townspeople, especially after the birth of their son.

Title: 242. Jungle Jim in the Forbidden Land
description: Jungle Jim is forced to lead anthropologist Dr. Edwards into a land inhabited by giant people.

Title: 243. Fanciulle di lusso
description: Lorna, the daughter of an American playboy, enters a girls' school for the international smart-set, in the Alps, where the main course of study appears to be how to trap a rich man. At first, she is dominated and looked down on by the school ring-leaders, and forced into rooming with - horrors - a scholarship student. But when a rich young American shows interest in her she is elevated to the international clique of the upper-termers. Then she falls in love with - horrors again - a poor local mountaineer.

Title: 244. Un rincón cerca del cielo
description: A poor man goes to the capital of México. He founds a woman, gets married, and has a life of love but also of poverty.

Title: 245. Captain Pirate
description: In 1690, pardoned pirate Captain Blood's quiet existence is shaken when the Crown re-arrests him on fresh piracy charges but the captain suspects he's being set up.

Title: 246. Jumping Jacks
description: Nightclub comic Hap Smith assumes the identity of another soldier so he can tour army bases in a revue with his ex-partner Chuck Allen.

Title: 247. I Believe in You
description: When a retired colonial serviceman takes a job as a probation officer he finds it a challenge. He and his colleague attempt to reform a hardened criminal and a juvenile delinquent from the London slums.

Title: 248. Trent's Last Case
description: A reporter investigates a rich businessman's death. While police rule it suicide, Trent believes it's murder and grows intrigued by the widow and secretary.

Title: 249. The Trap
description: After losing his vision during a storm, Carlos lives with his sister, Maria, off of the Indian coast in a fishing village. One day a mysterious young woman, Lisa, enters their lives, followed by a mysterious man, Tony Fernandes. Maria and Tony fall in love with each other, much to the chagrin of Simon, who loves Maria and wants to marry her. Lisa then warns Maria that she has known Tony, they have had an affair together, and he had betrayed her, however, this warning has no effect on Maria. Then a gypsy palm-reader also cautions Maria that she may be headed for disaster at the hands of a stranger. The question remains: who exactly are Lisa and Tony, and what is the reason behind their presence on this fishing community; and whether or not Maria is being drawn into a web of lies and deceit at the hands of Tony?

Title: 250. Little Big Shot
description: A boy tries to get himself a police record to impress the gang of criminals headed by his father.

Title: 251. Caribbean
description: Francis Barclay, a former member of the British Admiralty, who was captured in the early 1700s and sold into slavery by Andrew MacAllister, and forced into piracy, enlists the aid of Dick Lindsay, to help him invade MacAllister's fortified island. The latter falls in love with MacAllister's daughter Christine. Complications arise as the man thought to be a nephew of one man may not be, and the daughter of one man may be the other man's daughter.

Title: 252. Ma and Pa Kettle at the Fair
description: Ma and Pa are trying to raise enough money at the county fair to send their daughter Rosie to college. Ma competes in baking and Pa enters a trotter in a horse race, while Rosie takes up with handsome young Marvin Johnson.

Title: 253. This Is Cinerama
description: On the evening of September 30, 1952, the shape and sound of movies changed forever with the introduction of Cinerama.

Title: 254. El enamorado
description: Martin who has retired from his hero lifestyle because of his marriage with Rosary, returns to his heroic duties to help a friend from some assailants. Although Martin had promised his wife that he was done fighting crime, she gives in and returns his pistols. Marin promises to fight the Coyotes, who in return retaliate against Martin's family, making this a personal matter. (English Subtitled)

Title: 255. Meet Danny Wilson
description: A nightclub singer has a racketeer for a manager and a rivalry with his pianist for a girl.

Title: 256. Mexican Bus Ride
description: A newly-wed country boy receives the terrible news that his mother is dying, and takes a long and dangerous bus trip to the city to contact a notary for her last will and testament. Will he resist temptation and do the right thing?

Title: 257. Return of the Texan
description: During the 1950s, after many years in Kansas City, widower Sam Crockett, his 2 children and his grandpa return to their abandoned family farm in Texas and face many difficulties.

Title: 258. My Wife's Best Friend
description: After a man confesses to his wife that he has been unfaithful, she imagines all kinds of ways that historical figures such as Cleopatra and Joan of Arc might handle the situation.

Title: 259. Glory Alley
description: An about-to-retire New Orleans newspaper columnist tells the story of a most unforgettable character: boxer Socks Barbarossa.

Title: 260. Young Man with Ideas
description: A young lawyer encounters problems while relocating his family.

Title: 261. Babes in Bagdad
description: Hassan, the Kadi of Bagdad, has a harem housing twelve beauties, but concentrates his attention on Zohara. A newcomer, Kyra, introduces rebellion into the by the unheard of act of complaining to the Caliph about the lot of the women in the harem. Hassan suffers a greater shock when his God-son, Ezar, asserts that women are the equal of men. They make a wager under which Ezar must settle down with a conventional harem unless Zohara can outwit Hassan within ten days.

Title: 262. My Six Convicts
description: A psychologist pioneers a research study at a prison. He seeks the help of six savvy inmates including a safe-cracker, a mobster, a pair of armed robbers and psychopath. Could he trust them? What's in it for them?

Title: 263. Holiday for Henrietta
description: After the rejection of their latest--preposterous--scenario, two scriptwriters get back to basics to prepare a new movie. The new scenario centers on Henriette, a pretty, lively Parisian, and how she spends the 14th of July in Paris with her fiancé. We follow the tribulations of Henriette as various other characters enter the story and turn a traditional festive day into something more adventurous than expected.

Title: 264. Mademoiselle Gobete
description: A singer and operetta dancer works in a small french town where the authorities want to expel her because of her scandalous conduct and performance. When a puritan judge closes the show, the woman will take revenge involving the judge in an affair before the selfsame Justice minister. From that moment on, a series of diversions and misunderstandings will play out leading the main characters to the city of Paris.

Title: 265. The Golden Hawk
description: The seafaring adventures of French privateer Kit 'The Hawk' Gerardo during the Franco-Spanish-English war of the 17th century.

Title: 266. Flaming Feather
description: In Arizona during the 1870s, rancher Tex McCloud and cavalry Lt. Tom Blaine race to capture the notorious Ute renegade outlaw leader known as the Sidewinder.

Title: 267. Vendetta of a Samurai
description: Mataemon Araki, a renowned swordsman, helps a young man find vengeance.

Title: 268. Bombay Waterfront
description: The Temples investigate a series of gruesome murders attributed to a mysterious figure known as "The Marquis".

Title: 269. Actors and Sin
description: Two-part story--the first is about a washed-up Broadway actor and his tough daughter, who is a bigger star than he is; the second is about a literary agent whose newest client--a nine-year-old girl--is the author of a borderline pornographic book.

Title: 270. The Seven Deadly Sins
description: A French/Italian co-production with two episodes from Italy and five from France covering the seven deadly sins---actually eight as two of the sins are covered in one episode while a new "eighth unknown sin" has an episode of its own. Gerald Philipe is a wry, flip carnival barker who introduces each episode and then narrates the last episode dealing with the "eighth unknown sin" which is the sin of thinking evil where none exists. The first Italian contribution is "Avarice and Anger" concerning a well-to-do real estate agent and his frowzy wife, both uncompromisingly selfish in love and economics; the second Italian entry, "Envy", directed by Roberto Rossellini, from a story by Colette, is a glimpse into the newly-married life of an aging artist and his young wife, whom he treats as a chattel and she, consumed by the envy of his talent, friends and even his cat, tries to do away with the cat; "Pride" is about a couple of down-at-the-heels aristocrats trying to keep up pretenses in the face of utter poverty; "Lust" shows the devastating effects of careless adult behavior on an impressionable child; "Sloth" shows the powers above deciding that life on earth is moving at a too-fast pace and they send an emissary to slow things down, while "Gluttony" is a burlesque piece that the reviewers of the day called in bad taste.

Title: 271. Murder Will Out
description: A convicted female blackmailer is found murdered in her flat and suspicion falls on three suspects, all of whom Scotland Yard believe may have had reason to wish her dead.

Title: 272. Walk East on Beacon!
description: A G-Man searches for a communist sleeper cell in Boston.

Title: 273. Brave Warrior
description: In Indiana of the early 1800s, conflict once again arises between the United States and Great Britain over territory and boundaries. Each side endeavors to gain the support of the Shawnee Indian tribes in the area. Governor William Henry Harrison enlists the aid of Steve Ruddell, whose friendship with the Shawnee chief Tecumseh goes back to childhood. Tecumseh's leadership of the Shawnee is contested by his brother, known as The Prophet, who sides with the British. Tecumseh, who grew up as a childhood playmate of Steve and of Laura McGregor, loves Steve as a brother and hopes to marry Laura. But Laura is in love with Steve. Laura's father, Shayne McGregor, secretly leads local support of the British against the Americans, even though it risks the life and love of his daughter. Everything comes to a head at the battle of Tippecanoe.

Title: 274. The Assassin
description: Travelling to Venice to locate an ex-partisan on behalf of a French insurance company, a British private detective gets mixed-up in a political assassination conspiracy.

Title: 275. Brandy for the Parson
description: While on a yachting holiday, a young couple unknowingly give a lift to a charming smuggler and end up tricked into helping him transport illegal spirits across England, sparking a comical cross-country chase with customs officers.

Title: 276. Wagon Team
description: When bad guys steal a US Army payroll, stagecoach agent Gene goes undercover as a medicine-show entertainer to smoke them out.

Title: 277. Retreat, Hell!
description: The saga of a battalion of U.S. Marines during the Korean War, starting with their training, landing at Inchon in 1950, advance into North Korea and their subsequent retreat back to the 38th parallel.

Title: 278. Mara Maru
description: An American salvage diver plunges into dangerous intrigue around a sunken treasure in the Philippines.

Title: 279. Talk About a Stranger
description: In an idyllic setting, a likable but dangerously volatile twelve-year-old boy tries to settle a score with his disagreeable, new mysterious neighbor.

Title: 280. Bonzo Goes to College
description: The educated chimp moves in with a college football coach's family.

Title: 281. The Pathfinder
description: Follows a white man raised by Mohicans who joins British forces to avenge his people against Mingo and French enemies. He infiltrates a French fort to retrieve secret plans, navigating battles and personal vendettas.

Title: 282. El derecho de nacer
description: In Santiago de Cuba in the early 1950s, history begins. A young woman of high society becomes pregnant with a false love, her father orders his black maid (Dolores) to kill the baby (Alberto), but she flees to Havana where Alberto becomes a renowned doctor.

Title: 283. Here Come the Nelsons
description: While Ozzie tries to get some publicity for an ad agency, David and Ricky get mixed up with gangsters.

Title: 284. Dead on Course
description: When his girlfriend's brother's cargo plane is lost at sea, nagging questions arise, and pilot Richard Van Ness gets caught in a web of blackmail and smuggling.

Title: 285. Lightning
description: Poor, pathetic mother Ose has four children, three daughters and a son, by four different men.

Title: 286. Alraune
description: A scientist creates a beautiful "perfect woman", but since she is artificial, she seems soul-less and with no sense of morality, she brings ruin to all around her.

Title: 287. La laguna negra
description: The Black Lagoon in Urbión, its dark waters surrounded by mountains, hides the secret of a murder and the curse it carried over the village people.

Title: 288. The Ring
description: A young American of Mexican decent in East Los Angeles, California uses the boxing ring to make a better life for himself and his family, and learns as much about being a Latino in a white society as he does about boxing.

Title: 289. The Overcoat
description: Based on the Nikolai Gogol story but set in 1950s Italy, THE OVERCOAT is the story of a poor city hall clerk (Renato Rascel) whose only desire is to buy a new overcoat.

Title: 290. Strange Fascination
description: Pianist Paul Marvan is sponsored by wealthy widow Diana Fowler in America. He marries dancer Margo, straining his relationship with Diana. Facing financial troubles, he tries to collect insurance by intentionally injuring himself.

Title: 291. No Holds Barred
description: Sach acquires super strength, which the boys attempt to cash in on by turning him into a professional wrestler.

Title: 292. Lydia Bailey
description: In 1802, during Haiti's struggle for independence from Napoleonic France, an American lawyer seeks a client's daughter living on the revolution-torn island.

Title: 293. Daag
description: Living a poor lifestyle with his widowed mother, Shankar sells toys for a living, but is addicted to alcohol. He is attracted to Parvati, who also lives a poor lifestyle along with her step-brother, Jagat Narayan, his wife, and their daughter, Pushpa. After an argument with his mother, Shankar departs to the city, gives up drinking, earns a lot of money, and returns home just to time to pay off his mortgage. But his world will soon be shattered after he goes to ask for the hand of a now wealthy Parvati. This is where he will be forced to face his past, and ultimately be told that Parvati's marriage has been arranged elsewhere. Unable to live without Parvati, he takes up drinking again and heads on to a path of self-destruction.

Title: 294. Nishijin no shimai
description: A family of silkweavers are hit hard by industrialization.

Title: 295. The Inspector-General
description: Khlestakov is a young flamboyant crook, who is broke. He finds himself in a small Russian town, where local authorities are waiting for an undercover inspector from the capital St. Petersburg. Khlestakov is mistaken for an undercover inspector, and uses the situation for taking bribes from the local governor and flirting with both his wife and daughter. Khlestakov abuses the corruption and hypocrisy of the local authorities until, at the end, the real inspector shows up...

Title: 296. Sally and Saint Anne
description: Sally O'Moyne, a good-natured but awkward school-girl lives with her extended and eccentric Irish-American clan. One day at school, unable to find her lunch bucket, Sally says a prayer to St. Anne in hope of heavenly assistance. When Sally finds her lunch, she believes a miracle has happened, convincing her of a special relationship with the saint. Meanwhile, some animosity between the O'Moyne family and a neighbor grows and manifests itself in various comic situations. The plot develops as Sally, firm in her belief in St. Anne, emerges from adolescence an attractive young woman, and discovers the opposite sex. The feud, along with Sally's personal life, works itself to resolution in this light, nostalgic look at growing up Catholic in the 1940s and 1950s.

Title: 297. Mr. Lord Says No
description: After the Government decides to build a Festival of Britain exhibition site, everything goes to plan, all except the fact that the main road and the pedestrian subway into the site are blocked by a little corner shop which is owned and run by a Mr. Lord and his family. The Lords refuse to be bought off, and decline the compensation offered by the authorities. The police and the bailiffs try to evict them, only to come under fire from the family who have barricaded themselves inside the shop.

Title: 298. Stop, You're Killing Me
description: After the repeal of Prohibition, a beer-maker decides to sell beer legally, but no one wants to buy his revolting beer, and he does not want to force sales.

Title: 299. The Respectful Whore
description: Fred, the nephew of a senator,has murdered a Black man on a train. The two only witnesses are Lizzie McKay, a prostitute from New York, and Sidney, a colored man. Fred decides to seduce Lizzie in order to make her give false evidence according to which Sidney has attempted to rape her. The uncle also puts pressure on the young woman. After much hesitation, Lizzie finally accepts but Sidney, who has nearly got lynched, takes refuge at her home...

Title: 300. For Men Only
description: A college professor begins to suspect that a student's accidental death was tied to his refusal to take part in a traditional "hazing" and was no accident.

Title: 301. The Passionate Sentry
description: "Five-Sided Triangle", while geometrically incorrect, might be a better title for this film than the two it has. Arthur Crisp, a private in the Queen's Guards is forced to leave his ex-fiancée Christine in the empty house of a high-ranking civil servant whose son Miles discovers her there and promptly falls in love. His sister Alex decides that it would be best if Christine got together again with Arthur, not realizing that he's worshipped her from afar. A further complication is that Arthur's commanding officer is also in love with Alex.

Title: 302. Indian Uprising
description: In 1885 Arizona, prospectors illegally dig for gold on Apache lands, triggering an Apache retaliation against white settlers and trespassing miners, while the Army tries keeping the peace.

Title: 303. The Firebird
description: Italian opera singer visits the Royal Opera in Stockholm and falls in love with the prima ballerina.

Title: 304. The Treasure of Lost Canyon
description: In California, a boy and his adoptive father find an outlaw's hidden treasure but the news leaks out, sending unscrupulous characters after the gold.

Title: 305. Geisha Girl
description: "Rocky" Wilson and his sidekick, Archer McGregor, American soldiers en route home from Korea, stop over in Tokyo. They instantly get involved in a sabotage plot and, inadvertently, end up in the possession of some highly-explosive pills. But, with the help of Peggy Barnes, an American airlines hostess, and a crazy magician with hypnotic powers, they put an end to a scheme to take over the world. (Shot entirely in Japan.)

Title: 306. Full House
description: Three episodes of a police nature, one of them starring Maigret and the other Lemmy Caution.

Title: 307. Wait Till the Sun Shines, Nellie
description: At the fiftieth anniversary of his town's founding, the town's first barber recalls his long-dead, spirited bride and the flaw in his own character that helped bring about her loss and others.

Title: 308. A Woman Without Love
description: After indulging in an affair with a man (a friend of the family) she truly loves, a woman returns to her young son and husband for good, and loses contact with the man. Her husband is unaware of the affair. Twenty years later, there is news that the friend has died and left all of his money to the younger son in the family, which leads us to question this younger son's biological origin...

Title: 309. The Truth About Bebe Donge
description: François Donge, a wealthy mature man, is about to die. Flashback: many years ago, the seducer François meets Bébé, an idealistic young woman, and marries her. Her idealism crashes against François' personality.

Title: 310. Totò a colori
description: In the first Italian film to be shot in color, Totò portrays a musician named Antonio Scannagatti who strongly hopes to sell his composition, ''Epopea italiana'', to Tiscordi, who is one of the most important Italian impresarios. Will he succeed?

Title: 311. Thief of Damascus
description: A young man gathers a group of friends and adventurers to help battle an evil sultan.

Title: 312. Kid Monk Baroni
description: "Kid" Monk Baroni, the leader of a street gang, becomes a professional boxer to escape his life in Little Italy, New York.

Title: 313. The Blazing Forest
description: Kelly Hansen, the tough boss of a timber crew clearing property owned by Jessie Crain and her niece Sharon Wilks, is - unknown to anybody else - working to pay back money stolen by his brother Joe who has a changed his surname to Morgan, and who has no love for his brother. Just as the debt is about paid off, Joe is killed in a truck accident that starts a blazing forest fire.

Title: 314. Shadow in the Sky
description: Burt, former Marine, haunted by his wartime trauma, struggles with mental illness. His girlfriend hopes his family will help his recovery, but they hesitate due to their young children. Can Burt overcome his demons and find a path forward?

Title: 315. Sky Full of Moon
description: Harley 'Tumbleweeds' Williams is a mellow rodeo competitor who lacks entry fee cash. He enters a casino owned by Al and increases, then loses his money. Club employee Dixie hatches a plan to get both her and Harley a small fortune.

Title: 316. The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

Title: 317. El ceniciento
description: New in the city, Tin Tan's distant relatives abuse his good nature and have him work for them as a servant, until his godfather intervenes. A comic take on Cinderella.

Title: 318. The Sellout
description: During the 1950s, a small-town newspaper editor and a state assistant attorney-general fight corrupt local officials from one rotten county.

Title: 319. The San Francisco Story
description: In 1856, San Francisco is the scene of political battles between criminal organizations led by corrupt politicians and vigilante committees formed by honest citizens.

Title: 320. Dos caras tiene el destino
description: Roberto, once a great doctor, loses a patient because of his alcoholism. He flees far away, taking the identity of a man similar to him whom he has seen die.

Title: 321. The Frightened Man
description: Julius Rosselli, expelled from Oxford, defies his father by joining jewel thieves. His criminal activities culminate in an unexpected disaster, causing anguish for his father over Julius's life choices.

Title: 322. Les loups chassent la nuit
description: A secret agent is summoned by the head of a counter espionage organization, to Trieste where he is to unmask a potential enemy operating in Venice.

Title: 323. Eyes Leave Traces
description: Martin, a perfume seller coincide with his former classmate and bright, Roberto, who has left her lover planted tonight. Roberto Martin accompanies her home and meets his wife Berta, which falls in love. To get it, he will devise the perfect murder.

Title: 324. The Girl in White
description: A young woman decides to become a doctor at a time when women are not being made welcome in the field of medicine. Eventually, her determination and skills end up earning the respect of her male counterparts.

Title: 325. Kangaroo
description: In turn-of-the-century Australia, two criminals ingratiate themselves with a rancher in order to swindle him. However, the two partners become rivals for the affection of the rancher's beautiful daughter.

Title: 326. La tratta delle bianche
description: A police officer meets a girl who is near to falling into the net of shady individuals. To prevent this, he invites her into the police station and tells her a story.

Title: 327. Nødlanding
description: An American bomber is shot down over the western side of the Oslo fjord during World War II, and survivors are hidden in a church by local citizens to escape German occupiers.

Title: 328. African Treasure
description: Bomba the Jungle Boy captures a pair of nefarious diamond smugglers.

Title: 329. Love Is Better Than Ever
description: Dancing teacher Anastacia "Stacie" Macaboy (Dame Elizabeth Taylor) falls in love with smart theatre agent Jud Parker (Larry Parks). He likes her too, just not enough to give up his exciting bachelor life. So she plans to set a trap for him.

Title: 330. Hiawatha
description: Ojibway tribe member Hiawatha is sent by his chief to investigate the warlike intentions of the neighboring Dakotah and Illinois tribes that routinely trespass into Ojibway territory.

Title: 331. Target
description: To aid ranchers against a crooked land agent, Tim and Chito recruit a famed El Paso marshal...who turns out to be female.

Title: 332. Baiju Bawra
description: In Mughal Emperor Akbar's court, young musician Baiju challenges maestro Tansen to a musical duel in order to avenge the death of his father, which he holds Tansen responsible for.

Title: 333. A Girl in Every Port
description: After two sailors are conned into buying a lame race-horse, they go ashore to sort out the problem, but when they realize that the horse is one of a pair of identical twins, their plan for revenge becomes more complicated.

Title: 334. Póker de ases
description: Doña Chonita es muy estricta con sus cuatro hijos, Luis, Antonio, David y Pichi, asÍ como con su esposo mujeriego, Lencho. David se enamora deFelisa, una mujer de clasa alta, a pesar de que ella está comprometida con Eduardo.

Title: 335. Just for You
description: Jordan Blake (a widower) is a successful Broadway producer who has always been too busy for his children, Barbara and Jerry. His girlfriend Carolina, a musical comedy star, urges Jordan to take his kids on a vacation and get to know them before they are all grown up. Is Jordan already too late?

Title: 336. The Four Poster
description: Adapted from the prize-winning Broadway play that featured two people and a four-poster bed, in which the couple enacts their marriage, from 1897, until he dies some time after she has died from cancer. It is a love that endured wars, another woman and the death of their favorite son.

Title: 337. El mártir del Calvario
description: Mexican drama that follows the teachings to disciples and events in the life of Jesus Christ, previous and during his passion, then rising from the dead on the third day.

Title: 338. The Old West
description: Doc Lockwood and his gang are trying to take away Autry's contract for supplying horses to the stagecoach line. Parson Brooks joins Autry in an effort to clean up the town of Sadderlock.

Title: 339. 2 Minutes Too Late
description: An unreliable lover of women and a hunchbacked clockmaker are suspected of killing a beautiful woman. Only one of them has done it, but whom?

Title: 340. Mi esposa y la otra
description: A married man hires his cousin to stand up for him, when it is discovered that he has a mistress with three children.

Title: 341. The Devil Makes Three
description: In 1947, an American pilot returns to Germany to find a family that saved his life during WW2 but he stumbles upon a secret Neo-Nazi group.

Title: 342. Francis Goes to West Point
description: Francis the talking mule gets his owner in and out of trouble while he is taking basic training at West Point.

Title: 344. Ride the Man Down
description: Disputes over a dead man's property escalate into a bloody range war.

Title: 345. Twilight Women
description: Vivanne is thrown on her own when her lover is arrested for murder. Searching for a place to live, she eventually finds a room in a boarding-house run by a woman who provides room-and-board for unmarried mothers with an ulterior motive.

Title: 346. Voodoo Tiger
description: Jungle Jim helps an attractive research writer for the British museum clear up the mystery of a tiger cult in Africa while thwarting art thieves and bringing to justice a Nazi war criminal.

Title: 347. The Fighter
description: In Mexico, a young boxer uses his winnings to buy guns to avenge his family's murder.

Title: 348. Rainbow 'Round My Shoulder
description: Two singers (Frankie Laine, Billy Daniels) step in to help an aspiring actress (Charlotte Austin) whose grandmother opposes her bid to launch a show business career.

Title: 349. The Rose Bowl Story
